title: Extract a design system from design references
summary: You provide design references — screenshots, brand material, Figma files, or an existing app — and an AI tool distills them into a documented, evidence-backed design-system specification your team can build on.

interview.question: What references should the design system be extracted from?
options: UI screenshots or mockups I will provide
A Figma file or Figma variables
An existing app or project folder
interview.mapsTo: Task instruction: the extraction evidence sources.

interview.question: What should the result be used for first?
options: A reference document the team reads
The starting point for building components in code
A checkpoint to review before any product implementation
interview.mapsTo: Task instruction and required output files: the deliverable emphasis.

contractHints.instructionTemplate: Extract a reusable design-system specification from <evidence-sources>. Produce evidence-backed design principles, token architecture, and a component inventory, oriented toward <deliverable-emphasis>. Load the companion skill and follow its documentation and checkpoint conventions.
verificationHints: If the companion skill defines output validation steps, use those as the completion check.
Never write a completion check that repository evidence does not prove.
requiredArtifactHints: Require the design-system documentation output at the location the companion skill's conventions define for this project.
If the companion skill leaves the output location to the project, ask the user where the finished document should live, phrased as a plain-language choice.

prerequisites.description: Design references exist and are reachable by the automation.
prerequisites.evidence: User-provided screenshots, a Figma link with an available Figma integration, or an existing app folder inside the repository.
